thesis: Alphabet — Search + Google Cloud (growing ~63% YoY) + AI franchise (Gemini, TPUs). Announced an ~$84.75B equity raise to fund AI compute infrastructure (Berkshire Hathaway anchored $10B — a Buffett vote of confidence). Raise is ~1.8% dilution on a ~$4.5T cap company generating ~$174B TTM operating cash flow; consensus Moderate Buy, avg PT ~$413 (~10-15% upside). Down ~3% from entry on dilution-headline sentiment, not a thesis break. Sector: Technology.

AbbVie — diversified pharma successfully past the Humira patent cliff; immunology growth engines Skyrizi and Rinvoq compounding, plus neuroscience, oncology and aesthetics. Durable dividend payer. Up ~3.7%. First Healthcare slot. Risk: pipeline/regulatory, drug-pricing pressure. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Healthcare.

Eli Lilly — best-in-class GLP-1/obesity and diabetes franchise (tirzepatide) with a deep, durable pipeline. Buy consensus, avg PT ~$1,215-1,265. Up ~7%. Second Healthcare slot alongside ABBV. Risk: GLP-1 competition, pricing pressure, high valuation. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Healthcare.

JPMorgan Chase — best-in-class money-center bank; Q1 FY26 revenue +10% YoY, net interest income +9%, results beat. Buy consensus, median PT ~$345. Up ~3.7%. First Financials slot. Risk: rate/regulatory headwinds, credit cycle. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Financials.

Visa — global payments network with a durable toll-booth moat and secular tailwind from the shift to digital/cashless payments. Roughly flat since entry; thesis intact. Second Financials slot. Sector: Financials.

Costco — high-quality compounder; Q3 FY26 net sales +11.6%, comps +9.8%, membership fee income +10.7%. Buy consensus, avg PT ~$1,084-1,105. Up ~3.2%. First Consumer Staples slot. Risk: rich P/E ~48 leaves little margin for a growth stumble. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Consumer Staples.

Procter & Gamble — defensive consumer-staples blue chip; portfolio of category-leading brands with pricing power and a Dividend King track record. Up ~6.4%, leading among holdings. Second Consumer Staples slot. Risk: volume softness if pricing outruns the consumer, FX. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Consumer Staples.

McDonald's — defensive global restaurant franchise with a high-margin franchise-royalty model, dominant brand, and Dividend Aristocrat history; value menu resilient through consumer slowdowns. Up ~3%, in an uptrend. First Consumer Discretionary slot. Risk: traffic softness, FX, input costs. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Consumer Discretionary.

Honeywell — diversified industrial across aerospace, building automation, and energy/process solutions, with a planned breakup into focused standalone businesses as a potential value-unlock catalyst. Up ~0.7%. First Industrials slot. Risk: cyclical demand, execution on the separation. Hold weeks-months. Sector: Industrials.

Vanguard Total International Stock ETF — broad developed + emerging markets ex-US in one low-cost fund (ER ~0.05%). Provides geographic diversification. Down ~4.1% on a USD/international wobble; broad-fund long-term hold, not a thesis break. First International/Diversified slot. Risk: USD strength, EM/geopolitical volatility. Hold weeks-months. Sector: International/Diversified.
